description: This file defines the PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator class and associated services for managing PeekabooBridge hosts, socket paths, and related infrastructure within the OpenClaw application. It includes methods for starting, stopping, and maintaining legacy socket symlinks, as well as retrieving team identifiers via Security framework calls.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing the PeekabooBridge host lifecycle, socket paths, and legacy symlinks. Uses security and file system APIs to coordinate permissions, paths, and communication channels.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Encapsulates various services related to permissions, UI automation, window management, application control, etc., needed for the PeekabooBridge to function within the OpenClaw ecosystem.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host coordination, starting or stopping the host as needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the PeekabooBridge host and clears associated references.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the PeekabooBridge host if it is not already running, setting up services and paths.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures symlinks for legacy socket paths are correctly created and maintained.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates or updates a symlink at a legacy socket path pointing to the current socket path.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code signing team ID using Security framework APIs.

methods.name: makeSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs a socket path within a specified directory.
